text:
Sam Park: Heads up — EduCo's pre-sales questionnaire flagged KMS keys in a shared Redwood account. They're OK with a POC only if we either offer BYOK or provide written compensating controls + risk acceptance. Can security confirm if we can support a temporary exception for a 30–90 day POC window?

Maria Chen: Quick context — this is a tiny proof-of-concept, not full traffic. Customer expects to move to Dedicated or BYOK for prod. They want something we can share in the meantime so procurement signs off. Timeline: customer wants the POC in 2 weeks.

Jordan Patel: We can allow Redwood-managed keys for a limited POC if these compensating controls are applied and documented. Proposed controls (short):
- Dedicated tenant isolation for the customer's org
- VPC peering with strict egress rules (no general internet egress from POC instances)
- KMS access limited to a narrow service account with audited, time-bound permissions
- Audit log forwarding to customer's logging endpoint (immutable)
- Short-lived keys / key-rotation for the POC (<= 7 days)
- Pen-test evidence and SOC2 control references on request

Jordan Patel: Suggested risk statement for customer / procurement: "Redwood will use Redwood-managed encryption keys for the POC period only. Compensating controls (tenant isolation, strict network egress rules, auditable access, short key TTLs, and log forwarding) will be implemented. Customer acknowledges residual risk and agrees to migrate to BYOK or Dedicated managed keys for production. Exception expires automatically after 90 days unless renewed in writing."

Sam Park: That wording is perfect. Can you add a one-line action list we can include in the email (owner + ETA)? I'll send it to the customer.

Jordan Patel: Action list: 
- Apply tenant isolation + network ACLs (Owner: infra-team, ETA: 3 business days)
- Configure KMS role scoping & short TTL (Owner: eng-runtime, ETA: 2 business days)
- Enable audit log forwarding to EduCo endpoint (Owner: observability, ETA: 2 business days)
- Provide SOC2 / pen-test artifact pointer (Owner: security, ETA: 1 business day)
- Draft risk acceptance doc and get legal signoff (Owner: security + legal, ETA: 2 business days)

Nidhi Rao: From legal — OK to proceed with the exception text but require: (1) explicit 90-day limit, (2) commitment that production will use BYOK/Dedicated, (3) migration plan milestone in the doc, and (4) customer signature on the risk acceptance. Also: add a clause that exception can be revoked immediately if we detect suspicious activity.

Sam Park: Great — I'll send the email with Jordan's risk wording + action list and the legal caveats. I'll cc Nidhi and paste infra tickets once they're created. Thanks :thumbsup:

sec-bot: Created infra ticket INF-4123 and observability ticket OBS-1829 for the controls referenced above.

Jordan Patel: Ping me if procurement asks for specific SOC2 control IDs; I'll map them to our control matrix.

Sam Park: Sending now. Will update thread with customer reply and ticket links.
